description: Main source code for a Zephyr-based sensor application interfacing with MCP9808 temperature sensor, including trigger setup, temperature reading, and timestamping.

methods.name: now_str
methods.description: Returns current uptime as formatted string HH:MM:SS.MMM.

methods.name: set_window
methods.description: Sets temperature threshold window for trigger based on provided sensor_value.

methods.name: set_window_ucel
methods.description: Converts temperature in micro-Celsius to sensor_value and calls set_window.

methods.name: trigger_handler
methods.description: Handles temperature trigger events, fetches sensor data, and adjusts thresholds.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing device, setting trigger, and periodically reading temperature.
